reviews.author: Masood Ahmed
reviews.text:
I recently visited kommineni dental clinic for a tooth extraction and to fix a broken tooth, and I had a very positive experience. Dr. Harish explained the entire procedure clearly, which helped ease my anxiety.

The tooth extraction was done smoothly with minimal discomfort, and the dentist was very gentle throughout. For my broken tooth, the filling was done perfectly, and it now feels completely natural when I bite or chew.

The clinic was clean, well-maintained, and the staff were friendly and professional. Overall, I’m very satisfied with the treatment and would definitely recommend this clinic to anyone needing dental care.

reviews.author: bharath ganji
reviews.text:
Outstanding Dental Care – Went Above and Beyond!

I had an incredible experience at "KOMMINENI Dental and Craniofacial Cosmetic Clinic" With a flight scheduled for next week, I was worried about fitting in my treatment, but the team here went the extra mile to ensure everything was completed on time without compromising the quality of care.

The entire staff was welcoming, and the clinic itself is modern, clean, and very comfortable. The dentist took extra time to explain the procedure in detail, making sure I was relaxed and informed throughout. Even though they knew about my upcoming travel, they were patient, thorough, and never rushed any part of the treatment.

Their attention to detail and personalized care truly made a difference. The result exceeded my expectations, and I left feeling confident and well-prepared for my trip. Thank you for your exceptional service—I’ll definitely be back!
